venue.name: [Magneto The Mall](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CV1pXt1cKPcSLdhw9)

items.information:
**Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.**
Participants have to bring their own cube(s) for the competiton.

Please check out all the other tabs for more information(especially Registration & Payment tab).

Registration is a two-step process:
1. Register on the WCA page
2. Pay the registration fee (information given in registration & payment page)

Please note once you register in WCA site for the Raipur Winter Cube Open 2025, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list within 1-2 days.
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event, we will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and participation.

items.name: Sikat ng Taon Speedcubing Blitz 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDc1MzMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--148ee751b90399ee30d1e3327c9a2e7ea1a9a3f2/4pNVzXE.png)

Welcome to Sikat ng Taon Speedcubing Blitz 2025! To celebrate a new year for Philippine speedcubing, this competition features **ALL 17 WCA EVENTS**, with **3x3** as the main event!

For ALL Blindfolded Solvers, **3X3 BLINDFOLDED, 4X4 BLINDFOLDED, and 5X5 BLINDFOLDED will start at 10:15 AM and end at 11:30 AM.** [Please refer to the Blindfolded Events Tab for more information.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SikatngTaonBlitz2025#52029-blindfolded-events)

With possible availability of time, please note that there may be an additional **MYSTERY ROUND** added.
**By registering and confirming your registration for this competition, you hereby agree to be subject to the procedings of the Mystery Round if there be an allowance of time, regardless of round standing in the competition.**
[Please refer to the MYSTERY ROUND tab for more details.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SikatngTaonBlitz2025#52031-mystery-round)

We encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing.

This competition is hosted by Cubers and Friends, a private organization of Filipino Cubers dedicated to crafting competitive experiences.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDc1MzYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b893c497c575414d7451e2aeca2f8d4a8a169da0/kpYcjiQ.png)

items.name: Imagination Station B 2025

venue.name: [Imagination Station](https://www.imaginationstationtoledo.org/)
venue.details: Exploration Center - on the lower floor next to the cafeteria

items.information:
This competition is at the Imagination Station science center. Non-competing family members and spectators are **required to purchase a day pass** to the science center to enter the competition. A day pass is included in the competitor registration fee.

Imagination Station opens at 12pm - you will not be able to get in earlier than then.

items.information:
